description: Golden corpus for the vitaminc-aead-frame storage profile, version 1 (STORAGE.md). Rows are never edited or removed; new rows may be added. A reads row is a blob read by a type, and the value it reads as, in the form that type writes.

vectors.name: null
vectors.rule: null is 0x00; it is None, unit and a unit struct

vectors.name: i8_min
vectors.rule: an integer keeps its width: one tag per width, little-endian

vectors.name: u64_one
vectors.rule: equal values of different widths are different blobs

vectors.name: f32_one_and_a_half
vectors.rule: a float is its IEEE 754 bits, little-endian

vectors.name: f32_negative_zero
vectors.rule: the sign of zero is kept

vectors.name: f32_nan_payload
vectors.rule: a NaN's payload is kept

vectors.name: text_empty
vectors.rule: text is a u32 little-endian byte length, then UTF-8

vectors.name: text_nul
vectors.rule: text may hold NUL

vectors.name: bytes_empty
vectors.rule: bytes are a u32 little-endian length, then the bytes

vectors.name: bytes_utf8_is_still_bytes
vectors.rule: bytes that happen to be UTF-8 stay bytes

vectors.name: some_null
vectors.rule: Some(x) is 0xF5 then x: Some(()) is not None

vectors.name: some_some_null
vectors.rule: Some(Some(())) and Some(None) keep their nesting

vectors.name: array_empty
vectors.rule: an array is 0xF0, a u32 little-endian count, then the elements

vectors.name: object_empty
vectors.rule: an object is 0xF1, a u32 count, then each key (u32 length, UTF-8) and value

vectors.name: object_entries_keep_their_order
vectors.rule: entries keep the order they were written in

vectors.name: map_empty
vectors.rule: a map is 0xF6, a u32 little-endian count, then each key node and value node; a struct and a variant payload are objects, a map is a map

vectors.name: map_text_keys
vectors.rule: entries keep the order they were written in

vectors.name: map_u32_keys
vectors.rule: a key is an integer of any width, text, or bytes

vectors.name: map_mixed_keys
vectors.rule: keys of different kinds differ: 1, "1" and the byte 0x31 are three keys

vectors.name: variant_unit
vectors.rule: a unit variant is its name, as text

vectors.name: variant_newtype
vectors.rule: any other variant is an object of one entry: its name, then its payload

vectors.name: depth_128_arrays
vectors.rule: the root is depth 0; a node deeper than 128 is refused. A nest value is its leaf wrapped depth times: in a one-element array, a one-entry object under the key "k", a some, or a one-entry map under the key u8 0

vectors.name: depth_128_some
vectors.rule: the node after 0xF5 is one level deeper

vectors.name: depth_128_maps
vectors.rule: a map nests as its key 0u8 and the nested value

refused.name: empty
refused.rule: a blob starts with "VCS" and a version

refused.name: a_transport_frame
refused.rule: a transport frame is not a blob

refused.name: version_0
refused.rule: a version the reader does not read is refused apart from malformed bytes

refused.name: header_only
refused.rule: the body is exactly one node

refused.name: undefined
refused.rule: only the scalar tags in the table start a node

refused.name: some_with_nothing
refused.rule: a length, a count or a payload past the end is refused

refused.name: text_not_utf8
refused.rule: text and keys are valid UTF-8

refused.name: object_key_not_text
refused.rule: an object key is a u32 length and UTF-8, never a node

refused.name: duplicate_key
refused.rule: one object never has two entries with the same key

refused.name: map_key_null
refused.rule: a map key is an integer, text or bytes, and nothing else

refused.name: map_value_missing
refused.rule: a length, a count or a payload past the end is refused

refused.name: map_duplicate_text_key
refused.rule: one map never has two equal keys: text or bytes with the same bytes, or integers of the same value, whatever their widths

refused.name: depth_129_arrays
refused.rule: a node deeper than 128 is refused

reads.name: u8_as_u8
reads.rule: an integer reads as any integer type it fits

reads.name: f32_as_f64
reads.rule: an f32 reads as an f64

reads.name: integer_as_f64
reads.rule: a float type reads an integer too, as serde's float types do; an integer type never reads a float

reads.name: text_as_text
reads.rule: text reads only as text, and bytes only as bytes

reads.name: option_reads_null_as_none
reads.rule: an Option reads null as None, some as Some, and any other node as Some holding it

reads.name: option_of_unit_reads_null_as_none
reads.rule: a type whose own value is written as null reads its old null as None

reads.name: a_some_is_not_its_payload
reads.rule: a some reads only as an Option

reads.name: seq_reads_an_array
reads.rule: a sequence reads only an array

reads.name: struct_reads_an_object
reads.rule: a struct reads an object, or a map whose keys are all text, and nothing else; its fields may come in any order, and unknown keys are ignored

reads.name: struct_reads_a_missing_option_field_as_none
reads.rule: a missing Option field reads as None, as serde's derive reads it; any other missing field is refused

reads.name: map_reads_a_map
reads.rule: a map reads a map or an object; each key reads as the key type, as a value does

reads.name: enum_reads_a_unit_variant_name
reads.rule: an enum reads a variant name as a unit variant, or as a newtype variant whose value is read from null; and an object of one entry whose value is null as a unit variant

reads.name: struct_denying_unknown_keys_reads_its_own
reads.rule: a struct ignores unknown keys unless it denies them
